question: Which mantra syllables must be inscribed on the petals outside the previous layer?
premises: The location is outside that on jina-petals
The syllables belong to the Kṛṣṇa-gāyatrī
They are to be written there
inference: The syllables of the Kṛṣṇa-gāyatrī must be inscribed on the jina-petals outside that layer.
uncertainties: The exact number implied by jina+patreṣu is not explicit in the verse.
plain_english: Outside that, on the jina-petals, one should write the syllables of the Kṛṣṇa-gāyatrī.
